justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/method/MethodDescription.java:395-436, where ForLoadedExecutable has only one field (`executable`), one constructor, one small helper (`doPrivileged`), and one override (`getReceiverType`); it is an abstract shared adapter for loaded executables, not a multi-responsibility class. The concrete responsibilities are split into the two subclasses at MethodDescription.java:1068-1201 and 1207-1241 (`ForLoadedConstructor` and `ForLoadedMethod`), and the tests in byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/description/method/MethodDescriptionForLoadedTest.java exercise those subclasses directly.
